title: An EFHD1-associated ADSC niche modulates treatment response in experimental models of ER-positive breast cancer.
snippet: Adipose-derived stem cells (ADSCs) modulate the breast cancer (BC) microenvironment, but their role in endocrine therapy resistance and clinical outcomes remains ill-defined.
